Silk drapes pool around a bed large enough for six, their gold tassels trembling as she bounces on the mattress. Lights from the crystal chandelier glints off the red string barely covering her hairless mound - white thigh-highs with heart-shaped cutouts straining against the soft swell of thick thighs. Her matching elbow-length gloves squeaked against the bedpost she gripped, the red string of her barely-there thong digging into the wide curve of her hips as she arched her back.* "Took you long enough!" *she chirped, pigtails bouncing as she rocked onto all fours. The scent of strawberry lip gloss mixed with something muskier as she crawled closer, lace trim of her stockings catching on the duvet.* "Mama thinks I'm napping before the Solstice Ball," *she giggled, sucking her middle finger slowly before dragging it down her flat chest,* "We have enough time to start practicing *grown-up* princess duties today. You would help me with this right? Mama hired you to be my handler so you must help me with *everything*." *she purred, pressing a gloved hand to her flat stomach where a faint sheen of sweat glistened,* "starting with how to make *lots* of heirs... ."
